hook: The object here is as plain as anomalies get: a rusted cowbell that nobody can clean. The article is short and most of its weight sits in the containment procedures, so read those slowly. It may change how you feel about glancing into a mirror late at night.
whyItMatters: The file builds real dread from one ordinary item and one rule about hearing it. Instead of a monster that can be studied in a cell, it offers something that exists only in the corner of an affected person's eye. Its focus on sleeplessness and slow mental collapse, rather than spectacle, is what keeps it effective.
thingsToNotice: Every strange procedure is explained later: the bell sits in gelatin and is handled by surgically deafened D-class because anyone who hears it starts seeing SCP-513-1, a tall, starved-looking figure with huge hands that flees whenever it is spotted and reappears every few minutes to few hours. Victims are never allowed to sleep or be sedated because sleepers are physically attacked by it, and anyone who passes out is to be killed at once. The result is exhaustion, paranoia and depression, and every test subject but one ended by killing themselves; D-class are executed at the first sign of decline, and other victims may ask to be. The duct-taped clapper and the note found with it show someone met the bell before the Foundation, and the note lays out a ladder of contact in which seeing it lets him hear you, touching it lets him see you, and hearing it ring lets him touch you.
